verdict: All nine reproduced issues corrected in reviewed source; bounded independent review, not a claim of exhaustive correctness.

issues.original_failure: New curves ignored explicit explanation_rows when an audit was supplied.
issues.correction: New curves obey the explicit cap while the supplied audit remains unchanged.

issues.original_failure: One-class explanation samples aborted an audit despite valid full-evaluation AUC.
issues.correction: Full AUC remains available; sampled AUC importance is explicitly unavailable.

issues.original_failure: Reusing the seed inside a sorted outer sample biased the final PDP row sample.
issues.correction: The final curve sample is drawn directly from the original population; support has its own recorded rows.

issues.original_failure: Automatic boosting encoding could switch from contrasts in CV to categorical partitions at refit.
issues.correction: One outer-training resource plan fixes encoding across folds and refits; levels and preprocessing remain fold-local.

issues.original_failure: Native boosting accepted changed numeric, logical or categorical predictor kinds.
issues.correction: Prediction rejects changed kinds before coercion.

issues.original_failure: The report claimed curve and support used the same row count when they did not.
issues.correction: Curve and support row counts are recorded and displayed separately.

issues.original_failure: An entirely absent evaluation class received advice to increase the sample cap.
issues.correction: Missing sampled classes and missing full-evaluation classes receive distinct advice.

issues.original_failure: A supplied audit could cause old implicit curves to survive an explicitly changed cap.
issues.correction: Explicit caps regenerate implicit curves; explicit effects and supplied audits are preserved.

issues.original_failure: Automatic factor task inference failed when a declared evaluation class was unobserved.
issues.correction: Evaluation inference respects declared levels; training inference still uses observed classes.

checked: analytic prediction means and descriptive standard errors

scope_limits: The 100-seed PDP exercise checks actual row identities against a direct uniform draw; its empirical frequencies are descriptive and are not a statistical acceptance threshold.
CV/refit encoding fix assessed by production data-flow review plus the separately authored actual threshold-crossing workflow test; reviewer did not repeat that timed workflow.
No full-suite or million-row workflow verdict is implied by these small adversarial cases.
Fixed-model bands remain descriptive and exclude row-sampling, fitting and selection uncertainty.
